relationships.subject: GLP-1RA
relationships.evidence_quote: The thermal and mechanical allodynia were alleviated in DNP rats via intracerebroventricular administration of GLP-1RA or minocycline.

relationships.subject: GLP-1RA
relationships.evidence_quote: The expression of NLRP3 in brain microglia, which was found by RNA sequencing, was reduced in DNP rats by administration of GLP-1RA.

relationships.subject: GLP-1RA
relationships.evidence_quote: GLP-1RA attenuated NLRP3 inflammasome activation in microglia triggered by LPS.

key_findings: Brain microglia are activated in cortex and thalamus of diabetic neuropathic pain rats.
Intracerebroventricular GLP-1RA relieved allodynia and reduced microglial NLRP3 inflammasome activation.
